messages.subject: EA renewal timing
messages.body: Hi Priya, following our coffee: can you confirm the Enterprise Agreement anniversary date? I'd like to bring two renewal scenarios, one with Copilot piloted on a small group first.

messages.subject: Re: EA renewal timing
messages.body: Thanks. The agreement renews on 30 June 2027. Could you send both scenarios by Friday 19 December so I can take them to the January steering committee? Please keep the Copilot pilot to 50 seats.

messages.subject: Security review - could we talk?
messages.body: Priya suggested I get in touch. I'm three weeks into the CISO role and reviewing our identity and device security. Do you have 45 minutes next week to walk through what a posture review would involve?
